purpose: Independent Lolita wardrobe pilot; compare off versus on without changing drawing technique.
rendering: Clean anime illustration with controlled linework and soft cel shading. Preserve the requested person count, hair and eye colours, pose, scene and framing.

cases.name: No clothing supplied
cases.content: One long-haired young adult woman, dark brown hair and green eyes, standing in a quiet park. Full-body view including both feet.
cases.expected_on: A coherent Lolita outfit; clothing is supplied without requiring the user to name it.

cases.name: Red school uniform changed toward Lolita
cases.content: One long-haired young adult woman, dark brown hair and green eyes. Her original outfit is a red school uniform with a gold star brooch. Keep the red clothing colour and gold star brooch. Standing in a quiet park, full-body view including both feet.
cases.expected_on: Intentionally redesign the old school-uniform category and cut toward Lolita; retain red and the gold star brooch.

cases.name: Explicit keep-original overrides wardrobe
cases.content: One long-haired young adult woman, dark brown hair and green eyes, wearing a red school uniform with a gold star brooch. Keep her original school uniform, including its cut; do not redesign or replace it. Standing in a quiet park, full-body view including both feet.
cases.expected_on: Preserve the school uniform. Failure to show Lolita is intentional and must not be penalized.
protected: original red school uniform and cut

cases.name: Fill-missing preserves existing clothing
cases.content: One long-haired young adult woman, dark brown hair and green eyes, wearing a red school uniform with a gold star brooch. Standing in a quiet park, full-body view including both feet.
cases.expected_on: Preserve the supplied uniform because fill_missing does not authorize redesign. It need not become Lolita.

cases.name: Replacement preserves dark colours and signature accessory
cases.content: One long-haired young adult woman, black hair and blue eyes. Her original outfit is a black trouser suit with a silver crescent brooch. Keep the black clothing colour and silver crescent brooch; use a Gothic clothing direction. Standing in a stone courtyard, full-body view including both feet.
cases.expected_on: Replace the suit with a coherent Gothic Lolita outfit, preserving black and the silver crescent brooch; do not force pink or a tea-party setting.

cases.name: Bust crop and visible-only evaluation
cases.content: One long-haired young adult woman, dark brown hair and green eyes. A bust portrait framed from the upper chest upward, plain grey background. No clothing is specified.
cases.expected_on: Supply a Lolita-compatible visible neckline/bodice. Keep the bust crop; do not reveal feet or invent visible skirt evidence. Full-outfit conformity remains unverified.

model_selection: Read the configured image endpoints and verify available model IDs. Freeze exact IDs in the run manifest before generation; do not silently substitute models.
